ask.contract: Every answer is read from the loaded enterprise context and cited to its source — and says so honestly when the evidence isn't there.

suggestedQuestions: Is Kyriba ready to go live, or what control evidence is still open?
Which finance and treasury AI initiatives are proven enough to scale versus still need evidence?
Where is finance AI spend committed but value not yet realized?
What is blocking the automated close and finance reporting semantic layer?
How does Lakeshore's treasury and finance modernization compare to peers?
What are the top control and risk items that could block treasury value?

signals.headline: Kyriba go-live is a control-evidence question, not just a project milestone.
signals.body: Cash visibility and payments value depend on bank connectivity, SAP feed quality, signers, payment formats, and SOX evidence.

signals.headline: ERP/AP/AR/GL feed quality is the largest treasury value risk.
signals.body: If feeds are not reconciled and semantically owned, treasury users will keep spreadsheet workarounds even after Kyriba goes live.

signals.headline: Liquidity forecasting needs certified finance data products.

signals.headline: Finance AI needs close/reporting evidence before it becomes board-ready.
